note:
24333 -> 24278 (-55), and 24349 -> 24278 (-71) against the tree this commit was cut from. Measured as CI does, with the committed toolchain (node 22, node_modules from the package-lock.json): npx eslint . --format=json, then jq '[.[].errorCount] | add // 0'. warningCount is 2, unchanged and ungated.

THE FLOOR MOVES DOWN, AND EVERY UNIT OF THE MOVE IS THIS CHANGE. An earlier revision of this note raised the floor to 24349 on the reasoning that the strip touched only odoo/tests/dummy.js and therefore contributed zero, leaving the +16 of pre-existing drift to be absorbed. That was measured before the eslint half of this commit existed, and it is wrong: the strip travelled with a prettier/eslint --fix pass over the odoo/ JS it touched, and with the config change that onboards odoo/ to COMMUNITY_MODULES. Both endpoints are measured now -- a pristine 'git worktree --detach' at 55c43d3151a, node_modules symlinked, reports 24349; this commit reports 24278 -- and a per-file join of the two reports accounts for the -71 exactly, with no residue:

  -72  the seven odoo/ tour and test .js files the strip touched, cleaned to
       zero by the accompanying --fix pass: main_flow.js -40, x2many.js -16,
       test_ir_model_fields_translation.js -8, js_codefile.js -5, and -1 each
       for constraint.js, switch_company_access_error_tour.js and
       test_company_access_error_redirect_tour.js. These were already linted
       before this commit by the repo-wide recommended + prettier blocks --
       COMMUNITY_MODULES governs the stricter ruleset, not whether a file is
       seen at all.
   -4  test_assetsbundle/static/src/js/test_jsfile{1,2,3,4}.js, now ignored at
       config level. Their MINIFIED text is asserted byte-for-byte by
       test_assetsbundle.py, so no-var and no-unused-vars must not touch them.
   -2  odoo/tools/assets/js/esm_lexer_worker.mjs, which now gets the Node
       environment it always needed rather than browser globals.
   +7  eslint.config.mjs itself, which is 100% prettier/prettier debt (449 ->
       456 errors, no other rule): the 24 lines of rationale this commit adds
       are counted like every other line in that file. Reformatting it would
       clear all 456 at once and belongs in its own commit, not this one.

odoo/ now reports errorCount 0 across the whole package.

The +16 of drift the earlier note described is real and is still in the tree -- it sits inside the 24349 endpoint, and the -71 here more than offsets it, which is why the floor lands 55 below the old 24333 rather than above it. Whoever owns that web JS work still has 16 units to drive down; they are no longer parked in a raised floor.
